memory_update.text: AXTI is the cleanest US-listed underfollowed direct InP substrate candidate but has asymmetric dependence on China export permitting and Tongmei-related shipment cadence.
VECO is a second-order underfollowed tools candidate for the InP laser capacity buildout; the key evidence is $250M+ InP laser equipment orders tied to 800G/1.6T optical-transceiver manufacturers.
COHR and LITE should remain reference anchors, not primary underfollowed discoveries, because they validate downstream InP wafer/device demand and AI optical-interconnect capacity pressure.

Need a later pass on non-US or OTC-adjacent InP substrate/epitaxy suppliers, including Sumitomo Electric, JX Advanced Metals, IQE, and possible micro-cap photonics alternatives; these were excluded here to keep the pass US-listed and underfollowed-focused.

node: Indium phosphide wafers and optical substrates for AI networking
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the InP optical-substrate chokepoint with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane: COHR and LITE validate downstream demand for InP wafers, lasers, and AI data-center optical interconnects. Underfollowed lane: AXTI is the most direct US-listed InP substrate exposure, while VECO is a second-order tool/equipment beneficiary tied to InP laser manufacturing capacity expansion. No recommendation is implied; these are research candidates requiring further evidence checks.
